semantic_insights: The record distinguishes the current adult feature release, historical releases, controlled-access raw audio, and the separate pediatric dataset. Evidence from the pediatric dataset was not transferred to the root dataset.
The project DOI and version-specific citation DOI have different, explicitly explained scopes; their difference is not an identifier inconsistency.
Actionable platform access, recognized hosting, and source derivation are documented through meaningful equivalent fields despite absent dedicated download_url or publisher slots.
The documented processing software directly transforms distributed data, satisfying the processing-role threshold independently of capture and hosting platforms.
Descriptions of recruitment, site/device confounding, and demographic skew meaningfully identify bias categories without requiring a structured taxonomy field.
Privacy documentation acknowledges that voice-related re-identification remains possible and describes feature exclusions and access controls without promising complete anonymity.
Explicit sampling flags with false values provide meaningful documentation and were not treated as missing.
Source caveats preserve differences between historical and current evidence, including rejected malformed award strings and differing future enrollment targets.
